## Star69AI quality review

Before requesting review, complete the applicable checks.

- [ ] Readability: body copy, labels, tables and disclosures meet the design standards.
- [ ] Contrast: foreground/background pairs meet WCAG AA; focus, hover, disabled and error states checked.
- [ ] Responsive: reviewed at 360px, 768px and 1280px.
- [ ] Navigation: logo, mobile menu, Client Login, footer and internal links work.
- [ ] Forms: labels, keyboard access, validation, consent, submission and confirmation tested.
- [ ] Content: spelling, claims, pricing, business identity and contact details checked.
- [ ] SEO: title, description, canonical URL, heading structure and sitemap checked where applicable.
- [ ] Legal: effective dates, cross-links, optional-feature qualifiers and consistency with the actual product checked.
- [ ] Regression: existing forms, integrations, authentication and workflows preserved.
- [ ] Limitations: browser/provider tests not performed are clearly listed.

For legal-page changes, also run `node scripts/check-legal-pages.mjs`.
